stages.description: Required for director.dialogue_events and director.goal_plan (EventCard staging catalog). Omitted on director.daily_settlement to avoid irrelevant catalog inflation.

event_budget.description: Required for director.dialogue_events and director.goal_plan (player-phase EventBudgetView: day/capacity/spent/remaining). Omitted on director.daily_settlement because EventBudget opens only when entering player.

npc_participation.description: Locked entry policy for one way into the selected stage mechanic.

PriorActiveAgencyCommitment.description: Exact still-valid commitment from a related CharacterMind conversation with the current counterparties and absent from the recent dialogue turns. Server derives it from locked WorldState dialogue records; it is context, not a newly authored commitment.

world_view.description: Wider Director graph for day settlement: all active entities plus objective_traces subjects (retired unused entities omitted). Must omit stages and event_budget (settlement does not author EventCard staging; EventBudget opens only when entering player). Provider projection still drops empty objective_components and objective_traces.visibility.

Dialogue-related subgraph only: entity participants, one-hop relation neighbors, related facts, world machines, required stages catalog, and required event_budget (EventBudgetView). Not the full world graph.

dialogue.description: Locked DialogueRecord projected to exactly the current completed exchange: the triggering human turn followed by its character_mind or director_system responder turn. Conversation history remains outside this per-turn EventCard decision.
Locked DialogueRecord projected to the deployment-owned recent-turn window. The protocol permits no more than the ProviderDialogueView safety limit; WorldState remains complete.

prior_active_commitments.description: Still-valid commitments authored by this CharacterMind in related conversations with the current counterparties but absent from dialogue.turns. Always present; recent-turn commitments remain only on their original turns and are not duplicated here.

context.description: Deprecated on model drafts. Server materializes situation.context as {}. If present, must be an empty object; non-empty context is rejected (no world_view echo).

subject_indices.description: Optional. Omit to inherit situation.subject_actor_indices. When present, Server keeps only indices inside the situation (and actor table); empty after filter inherits situation.

subject_actor_indices.description: Optional. Omit or [] → Server fills all world_view.actors indices.

target_actor_indices.description: Optional; empty/omit → Server uses all character-capable actors or all actors.

agency.description: Optional structural noise on day settlement. Server does not materialize agency_gates from this field (no dialogue commitment_evidence channel). Omit preferred; EventCard path owns commitment-backed gates.

DialogueCommitmentSelector.description: Server-internal ordinal pair into DialogueRecord.turns[i].agency_commitments[j]. Not a model-authored EventCard field; Server assembles evidence from transcript only.

EventCardAgencyGateSemanticDraft.description: Non-prefab model-authored gate shell only. For prefab_bind, omit or []; Server derives the gate from the selected entry mode npc_participation and current responder commitment. commitment_evidence is always Server-owned from the current exchange.

agency_gates.description: Optional gate shells for non-prefab outcomes. For prefab_bind, omit or []; Server derives the effective gate from stage policy and the current responder commitment. Never copy commitment evidence or subjects into a second truth.

agency_decisions.description: Optional. Omit or [] when event.agency_gates is empty; Server defaults missing to []. Non-empty only when gates exist.

event_cards.description: Call director.dialogue_events only when EventBudget remaining > 0; the call must produce exactly one EventCardSemanticDraft. remaining === 0 skips this model call entirely (no fabricated empty output).

commitments.description: This-turn commitment delta; decide it before writing reply and always include the array. Use [] when no new or materially changed face-to-face executable commitment is created, including when merely recalling or confirming a still-valid prior_active_commitment. Any newly granted authorization for a mutual action to start now, including a short challenge-acceptance signal, requires a non-empty item that EventCard agency_gates may cite.

ProviderPriorActiveAgencyCommitmentView.description: Still-valid CharacterMind commitment from before the recent raw-turn window. It must influence continuity but does not itself authorize a new current-turn commitment.

agency_commitments.description: character_mind turns always project this array (including [] when no promise). Other speakers must omit the field.

turns.description: Server-owned recent dialogue projection with a protocol safety maximum of 24 turns. Each operation may use a smaller explicit window; models must not invent summary structures.

dialogue.description: Locked DialogueRecord projected by Server within the 24-turn protocol safety maximum.

world_view.description: Dialogue-related subgraph only: entity participants, one-hop relation neighbors, related facts, world machines, required stages catalog, and required event_budget (EventBudgetView).

dialogue.description: Locked DialogueRecord projected by Server within the 24-turn protocol safety maximum.
Locked DialogueRecord projected by Server within the 24-turn protocol safety maximum.
